binary_format_evidence_matrix.in_binary_non_loaded_carrier: Non-allocated section `.anneal.evidence` (`SHT_PROGBITS`, `sh_flags = 0`, `sh_addr = 0`) or `.note.anneal.evidence` (`SHT_NOTE`, `sh_flags = 0`). Excluded from all `PT_LOAD` program headers; zero runtime virtual memory impact.
binary_format_evidence_matrix.detached_key_identifier: `NT_GNU_BUILD_ID` in `.note.gnu.build-id` (20-byte SHA-1 or 32-byte SHA-256 digest emitted via `-Clink-arg=-Wl,--build-id=sha1` or `sha256`), plus full file SHA-256.
binary_format_evidence_matrix.strip_and_signing_behavior: Both GNU `strip` (`--strip-debug`, `--strip-unneeded`, `--strip-all`) and `llvm-strip` preserve non-allocated non-`.debug_*` sections unless `-R .anneal.evidence` is explicitly passed. `objcopy --only-keep-debug` + `strip` workflows retain `.note.gnu.build-id` in both stripped binary and `.debug` sidecar.

binary_format_evidence_matrix.in_binary_non_loaded_carrier: Mach-O requires every section in a segment (`__TEXT`, `__DATA`, `__DATA_CONST`) to belong to a `LC_SEGMENT_64` load command mapped into virtual memory (`vmsize > 0`), EXCEPT raw data appended to `__LINKEDIT` before `codesign`. Appending custom unreferenced sections to `__LINKEDIT` or mutating a binary after `codesign` invalidates `LC_CODE_SIGNATURE` (causing `SIGKILL` `EXC_BAD_ACCESS (Code Signature Invalid)` on Apple Silicon).
binary_format_evidence_matrix.detached_key_identifier: `LC_UUID` (16-byte deterministic UUID computed by `ld64`/`ld-prime`/`lld` over output content) + `CDHash` (CodeDirectory SHA-256 hash inside `LC_CODE_SIGNATURE`) + file SHA-256.
binary_format_evidence_matrix.strip_and_signing_behavior: `dsymutil` extracts DWARF into `<bin>.dSYM/Contents/Resources/DWARF/<bin>` keyed by `LC_UUID`. Detached `.anneal.bundle` keyed by `LC_UUID` + SHA-256 (or stored inside `<App>.app/Contents/Resources/` and covered by `CodeResources`) survives `strip -x`, `dsymutil`, and `codesign`/`notarytool` without inflating runtime VM.

binary_format_evidence_matrix.in_binary_non_loaded_carrier: PE section headers (`IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER`) allow `IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE` (`0x02000000`) or `IMAGE_SCN_LNK_INFO`, or data appended after the last section via `IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DEBUG` (`IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_UNKNOWN` / custom vendor entry). However, Authenticode (`IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY`) hashes all sections and trailing bytes preceding the certificate table.
binary_format_evidence_matrix.detached_key_identifier: `IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY` CodeView `RSDS` signature (16-byte GUID + 32-bit Age + PDB path) + PE Header Checksum/Timestamp + file SHA-256.
binary_format_evidence_matrix.strip_and_signing_behavior: Modifying a PE32+ file after `signtool sign` breaks the Authenticode PKCS#7 signature. Emitting a detached `<bin>.anneal.json` / `.anneal.tar.zst` bundle keyed by the PE SHA-256 and CodeView `RSDS` GUID (and optionally embedding a tiny 64-byte `.anneal` digest descriptor section *before* `signtool` runs) preserves both zero runtime footprint and Authenticode validity.

rustc_reproducibility_controls.scope: Remaps workspace, rustup sysroot, and cargo home paths in `Location::caller()`, panic strings, DWARF `DW_AT_comp_dir`, and crate metadata (`compiler/rustc_session/src/config.rs`).
Eliminates multi-CGU partitioning and parallel LLVM/backend scheduling variance.
Uses deterministic content-derived `StableCrateId` + `DefPathHash` (`compiler/rustc_symbol_mangling/src/v0.rs`) without legacy hash perturbations.
Disables incremental compilation work-product reuse (`compiler/rustc_incremental/`), which embeds session directory state.
Pins archive member timestamps in `.rlib` / `.a` archives and PE COFF header timestamps.
